_comment: Remote collector instances this machine may query, and the credential for each. Copy to remote_endpoints.json and fill in. Nothing reads this file at runtime - the collector does not know it exists. It is a note to whoever is working here, machine-readable so a session does not have to be told the URL again.
_rules: The real file is gitignored. It never becomes tracked, never reaches the bus, never gets pasted into an issue.
One token per consumer, so revoking one does not disturb the others. This one is the operator's; the consuming project has its own.
The token authorises exactly the grants listed beside it. If a route answers 403, the grant is missing - it is not a bug in the route.
Print the URL freely, never the token. A command that needs it reads it from here.

live.instance_id: <minted at the data root on first start; /v1/status states it>
